strings.정오각형은 대각선을 한 변으로 나누면 꼭 1.618이 나와요. 어림이 아: Divide a diagonal of a regular pentagon by one of its sides and you get exactly 1.618 — not close to it, exactly the golden ratio.

strings.여러분이 앱에서 한 활동들을 돌아보았어요. 이 활동들을 떠올리며 비와 비: You have looked back at the activities you did in the app. Thinking about them, sum up in your own words what a ratio and a rate are.
strings.두 수를 나눗셈으로 비교하기 위해 기호 :을 사용하여 나타낸 것을 비라고: When we compare two numbers by division and write them with the sign :, we call it a ratio.
strings.한 양을 기준으로 다른 양이 몇 배가 되는지 비교하기 위해 비로 나타냅니: We write a ratio to compare how many times one amount is, taking another amount as the base.
strings.예) 다섯 칸에 칠한 빨강 2칸과 노랑 3칸을 비교할 때 2 : 3이라: Example) When we compare the 2 red squares and the 3 yellow squares painted in five squares, we write 2 : 3 and read it “2 to 3.” We can also say “the ratio of 2 to 3” or “the ratio of 2 with 3 as the base.”
strings.기준량과 비교하는 양: Base amount and amount being compared
strings.기준량은 비교할 때 기준이 되는 양입니다. 비교하는 양은 기준량에 비해: The base amount is the amount we compare against. The amount being compared is the amount we want to measure against the base amount.
strings.예) 100칸 가운데 빨강 40칸을 칠했을 때 전체에 비해 빨강이 얼마만: Example) When 40 of 100 squares are painted red and we find how much red there is compared with the whole, the base amount is all 100 squares and the amount being compared is the 40 red squares. As a ratio, it is 40 : 100.
strings.비 40 : 100에서 기호 :의 오른쪽에 있는 100은 기준량이고, 왼: In the ratio 40 : 100, the 100 on the right of the sign : is the base amount, and the 40 on the left is the amount being compared.
The size of the amount being compared relative to the base amount is called a rate.
strings.(비율) = (비교하는 양) ÷ (기준량) = (비교하는 양) / (기준: (rate) = (amount being compared) ÷ (base amount) = (amount being compared) / (base amount)
strings.예) 비 40 : 100을 비율로 나타내면 40 ÷ 100 = 40/10: Example) The ratio 40 : 100 as a rate is 40 ÷ 100 = 40/100 = 0.4.
strings.기준량을 100으로 할 때의 비율을 백분율이라고 합니다. 백분율은 기호: A rate with the base amount taken as 100 is called a percentage. A percentage is written with the sign %.
Example) The rate 40/100 (0.4) as a percentage is 40%.
